_sobre: Arte da página inicial (o banner do topo da home), no mesmo formato de pedido do bestiário: node scripts/bestiario.cjs --lista inicio --seed <n> capa-inicio. Mesma paleta dos covers e mesma direção de arte do bestiário.
estilo: , Naruto anime and manga style, faithful to the Naruto anime designs, cinematic key frame of the Naruto anime, bold artistic camera angle, dramatic perspective and lighting, dynamic asymmetric framing, the action caught mid-movement, pixel art scene, warm muted palette, crisp pixels
paleta_nota: A paleta dos covers das vilas (static/covers; a mesma imagem de cores de scripts/args/seed-capa-nevoa.json). Cada verbete pode somar cores_extras quando o uniforme ou a criatura precisa de uma cor que ela não tem (o azul-marinho e o verde-oliva de Konoha, que sem isso saíam cinza).

capa.uso: banner da página inicial (proporção 8:3, a mesma do cover antigo)

aereo.prompt: bird's eye view from very high above

holandes.prompt: dutch angle, the camera tilted diagonally

verbetes.prompt: Konohagakure at golden sunset, the Hokage Rock cliff in the background on the right with exactly four huge carved stone faces of the Hokage looking over the village, the round red Hokage tower with the kanji 火 in the middle ground, red and brown roofs and green trees, four ninjas in green Konoha flak jackets leaping from rooftop to rooftop in the foreground toward the left, cherry blossom petals blowing, warm orange and purple sky, like the opening of the Naruto anime

referencias.uso: the Hokage Rock of Konoha as drawn in the Naruto anime: giant carved stone faces on the cliff above the village. Use only the classic four or five faces; ignore the modern tall buildings
the round red Hokage tower with the kanji 火 on the roof, as in the Naruto anime; draw it in warm sunset light
